title: Grateful Dead Live at Capital Centre on 1990-03-15
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.8 MHz) >KORG AudioGate 4 > Adobe Audition CC2015 > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/24
source: Ultra Matrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-X90)

ai_review.summary: Energetic performance with Brent on fire and jammy Garcia, captured in a generally excellent matrix recording that slightly buries the guitar.
ai_review.review: The show is described as very energetic and fun, with Brent Mydland having an especially strong night and Jerry Garcia in a jam‑friendly mood. The UltraMatrix source provides a clear and lively mix, though one reviewer notes that Garcia's guitar could have been louder in the balance.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review; it rates the show 4/5 and praises both performance and recording, with a minor mix complaint. The rating reflects a good‑to‑great show and solid recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Overall clear and lively matrix capture; some reviewers feel Garcia's guitar is a bit low in the mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: High‑energy throughout with no specific set‑break comments, but consistently fun and jammy.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Jammy mood; guitar tone praised but could be louder in the mix.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland highlighted as having a strong night.
